name: Chesapeake Bay Small Watershed Grants
summary: Annual NFWF grants, funded mainly by the US EPA, for community-based projects that protect and restore water quality and habitat in the Chesapeake Bay watershed. Implementation grants fund on-the-ground work; smaller planning and technical assistance grants prepare future projects.

amount.note: Implementation grants; planning and technical assistance grants go up to $150,000

reporting: Grantees choose the most relevant project metrics from NFWF's list in Easygrants and report against them.

geography.quote: All projects must occur wholly within the Chesapeake Bay watershed.

access.quote: All application materials must be submitted online through the National Fish and Wildlife Foundation's Easygrants system.

amount.quote: SWG Implementation (SWG-I) grants of $150,000-750,000 will be awarded for projects that result in direct, on-the-ground actions to protect and restore water quality, species, and habitats in the Bay watershed.

co_finance_required.quote: non-federal matching funds are encouraged but not required

reporting.quote: the Chesapeake Bay Stewardship Fund has a list of metrics in Easygrants for proposal applicants to choose from for future reporting

window.quote: Proposal Due Date Thursday, April 2, 12:00 PM ET
